trust_classes.approved_data_source: May be used for the stated research purpose subject to licensing and point-in-time rules.
trust_classes.approved_dependency: May execute inside Commodity within an explicitly bounded role; exact versions belong to lock/config owners.
trust_classes.primary_technical_source: Owner-published SDK, protocol, or API implementation usable as integration evidence.
trust_classes.discovery_reference: Useful for patterns or source discovery but not authoritative for data semantics or rights.

technical_sources.use: MCP protocol, SDK, and reference patterns

external_model_rule: External model repositories may be used only through bounded adapters; enablement, model pins and runtime settings belong to config/models.json.
licensing_rule: Licensed raw market values stay out of Git unless terms explicitly permit repository storage; private research rights do not imply redistribution rights.
